integrity: Original proof and reproducible independent integer-arithmetic checks are included. Finite checks do not certify the infinite theorem. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact uniform-triple counts only for the two dual strong-connective distributivity equations in standard finite Łukasiewicz MV chains; no claim about other equations, nonchain algebras or nonuniform distributions. Related inaccessible text leaves an originality-priority risk.
title: Exact dual distributivity spectra in finite Łukasiewicz chains
